scope_definition: Current consumer mobility operations marketed directly by DiDi or through a DiDi-owned local consumer brand. Country presence requires current official evidence; city presence requires an official local operating-city index. Excludes historical launches without current confirmation, office/careers presence alone, food/fintech-only presence, unaffiliated taxi/JV products, overseas-travel aggregation, and unverified press/social claims. City-list presence is not a polygon, corridor, boarding-point, demand, or fare claim.
